eMbrace for Individuals

Personalized Assessments, Therapy & Growth-Oriented Care

Whether you're managing anxiety, building emotional resilience, or seeking support for neurodivergence, eMbrace offers personalised expert-led care designed to fit your lifestyle and support your goals.
Tailored support for self-awareness, mental well-being & everyday functioning. Book a Session

What We Offer

Evidence-Based services personalized for you

AssessmentsGet clear answers with gold-standard evaluations
  • Self-Discovery & Personality Profiles
  • ADHD, Autism & Neurodivergent Screening
  • Mood, Anxiety & Diagnostic Reports (ICD-10/DSM-5 aligned)
    • Know yourself better to choose the right care path.
    Individual TherapyOne-on-one therapy for a healthier mind and life
  • Anxiety, Depression, Trauma, Self-Esteem
  • Adult ADHD, OCD, Emotional Regulation
  • Grief, Life Transitions & Burnout
    • Goal-based, structured therapy to support real-life change.
    Psychiatric ConsultsExpert medication management & diagnosis
  • Initial Evaluation
  • Ongoing Psychiatric Support
  • Collaborative Care with Therapists
    • Medical support, when and if needed, with full transparency.
    Support for NeurodivergenceEmpowering neurodiverse adults to thrive
  • Executive Function Coaching
  • Sensory, Social & Emotional Skills
  • Workplace & Life Skills Training
    • Strengths-based approach to ADHD, Autism & more.

    Frequently asked questions

     If you're experiencing stress, low mood, difficulty in relationships, or need clarity about your mental health, starting with a consultation can help. Our experts will guide you on whether therapy, assessment, or another service is the best next step.

    Free · 3 minutes · private

    Stressed, or burnt out? They need different things.

    Our self-check gives you four separate scores — worry, mood, body and sleep, and burnout — because those four problems look identical from the outside and respond to completely different treatment. Your answers stay in your browser, and the 7-Day Reset Plan has a track for whichever one is heaviest.
